items.name: Manila Sides Standoff 2024

venue.name: Mind Zone España
venue.address: 1139 España Place Building Unit 201 Adelina Street, Corner España Blvd, Sampaloc, Manila, Metro Manila

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2hUIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aaa08f452192183cc190f1119549fd736a5ba99d/dS5SYCl.png)

Welcome to Manila Sides Standoff 2024, Cubers and Friends's first organized competition in the Philippines, and get ready to clash your side puzzles together! This competition features the side events **Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1, Clock, and 3x3 Multi-Blind**, with **Pyraminx** as the main event.

Given the speciality of this competition towards side events, time limits and cutoffs for majority of the events are lower than your usual competition, so this competition is more recommended for cubers looking for a challenge. If you are looking for a more typical competition experience, feel free to check out [other competitions happening in the Philippines.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Philippines&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

NOTE: As the venue's size is limited, competitors may bring **at most 1 guest** to spectate. However, additional guests per competitor may spectate at a fee of **Php 300 per additional guest**. Competitors are also encouraged to have their lunch **before** the competition, as **there will be no lunch period** as scheduled.

For more information regarding guest and venue guides, please refer to their respective tabs above.

items.information:

Top 3 finishers in each event will be awarded gift cards from TheCubicle!
